description: Phase B. 2026-01 audit: default metadata_merge_fn was a no-op discarding resolver updates. finalization.ex now has apply_metadata_updates — verify commit-proxy server wiring, system-key parse/merge, and add the integration test (director commits metadata key -> resolver accumulates -> proxy applies). Then move shard-map authority from TSL to system keys; Distributor rebuilds from it (FDB: DD rebuilds from keyServers/serverKeys).

comments.text: Rescoped 2026-07-15 per epic: materializer locations leave the TSL for the \xFF keyspace (FDB keyServers/serverKeys model). Prereq: verify metadata distribution end-to-end (original scope of this ticket). Exit criterion: apply_tsl_delta + steady-state tsl_updated broadcast deleted; clients read map from metadata shard or proxy MetadataAccumulator (design choice open); Distributor publishes coverage transactionally. Related: bedrock-ri40 (system-key encoding), bedrock-0u3 (delta validation — moot once channel retired), bedrock-v65 (broadcast liveness — moot for routing).

Landing path inverted 2026-08-19 (see bedrock-q67.20): the five prerequisite implementations are being ported from feature/q67-phase-a onto develop as a PR series (proxy-owned routing table first, then ri40 encodings, q67.18 clearing, q67.15+16 window distribution, q67.17 deferred accumulation). This ticket then proceeds ON DEVELOP. Note: the exit criterion's 'Distributor publishes coverage via transactional system-key writes' still requires the Distributor, which exists only on feature/q67-phase-a - phase-a reconciliation (now much smaller: its TSL-delta channel and metadata-pipeline copies are dropped, not merged) or a develop-side coverage writer is a remaining prerequisite for the full exit criterion.

Distributor prerequisite now tracked as bedrock-q67.21 (port from phase-a with keyspace-mutation publication per the FDB MoveKeys/ApplyMetadataMutation model; PR #97 closed). This ticket and bedrock-q67.21 land in coordination: q67.9 owns the client read path + tsl_updated deletion, bedrock-q67.21 owns the coverage writer + healing loop.

Reassessment 2026-08-20, post trim campaign (stacks #161/#166 collapsed into the integration branch): (1) The 'verify wiring/parse/merge + integration test' scope is DONE via q67.20 and superseded by better machinery - converged verdicts (q67.22), exact per-proxy window relay (q67.33), serialized apply-then-route (q67.24). Stale references in this ticket: metadata_merge_fn and the proxy MetadataAccumulator option no longer exist. (2) The open design choice 'clients read map from metadata shard or proxy MetadataAccumulator' is effectively settled by FDB + the trims: FDB serves GetKeyServerLocations FROM COMMIT PROXIES out of keyInfo (CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp:3063-3097), the commit-stream-fed view; Bedrock's keyInfo analogue is RoutingData - alive, immutable, exact-relay-fed. Read path = client asks a proxy, proxy replies with its immutable RoutingData snapshot (O(1) on BEAM). The deleted structured Metadata store was never the right vehicle; the metadata-shard read survives only as the q67.23 bootstrap seed. (3) Remaining scope here: client read path via proxy snapshot + invalidate-and-reread on staleness; delete steady-state tsl_updated broadcast + TSL shard fields; coordinate with q67.21 (coverage writer). (4) Blockers concretely: q67.20 closes when #152 lands; q67.23 awaits confirmation of the recorded seeded-recover_from proposal (now nearly free - snapshot is plain data, apply-then-use gives the epoch's first commit self-routing); q67.21 gates only the writer half - the read path can start the day #152 lands.

DESIGN PROPOSAL 2026-08-20 (from paired deep-reads: Bedrock TSL-consumer census + FDB NativeAPI/CommitProxyServer location protocol). Facts first: (1) tsl_updated has ZERO mid-epoch sends today - every broadcast is recovery-bound (publish recovery.ex:218, nil-clear director_management.ex:41, replay-on-register server.ex:178). The channel is already FDB's ClientDBInfo, which FDB KEEPS (proxy/GRV interfaces ride coordinator push, NOT the keyspace - ServerDBInfo analogue). (2) Client field census: reads need {shard_layout, shard_materializers, metadata_materializer}; wiring needs {epoch, sequencer, proxies}; id/director/rate_keeper are DEAD fields. (3) RoutingData lacks tag=>materializer - FDB puts exactly this in the keyspace (serverList/, interfaces not ids; GetKeyServerLocationsReply returns full StorageServerInterfaces from keyInfo). DESIGN (D1-D7): D1 Two channels, FDB-parity: wiring stays on the coordinator push (shrunken TSL = ClientDBInfo analogue); shard locations become proxy-served from RoutingData (GetKeyServerLocations analogue, CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp:3028-3108). D2 Materializer interfaces enter the keyspace: new family materializer/<tag> -> encoded {otp_name,node} ref (OtpRef codec returns WITH this reader), recovery clear+rewrites it (persistence), RoutingData folds it, Distributor mutates it later (q67.21). shard->tag already rides shard_keys/. D3 Client path: TransactionBuilder builds LayoutIndex from a proxy-fetched routing snapshot; Link caches it node-wide (DatabaseContext locationCache analogue: no TTL, invalidate on routing failure); Repo turns layout_lookup_failed/no_servers_to_race from permanent raises into invalidate+refetch+retry (FDB: wrong_shard_server never escapes to the user, NativeAPI.actor.cpp:2021-2024, flat 10ms delay). D4 Whole-snapshot fetch, not per-key ranges - justified divergence: RoutingData is an immutable value, O(1) to hand over; map is small; narrows later if scale demands. D5 Proxy refuses routing requests until recover_from has seeded it (FDB validState gate, CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp:3036). D6 No materializer-side wrong_shard_server check YET: mid-epoch shard moves do not exist until q67.21 lands the Distributor; staleness today = wrong_epoch/dead-pid, already retryable. The ownership check lands with the mechanism that creates the hazard (guard-only-real-hazards). D7 The kill: TSL loses shard_layout/shard_materializers/metadata_materializer + dead fields (id, director, rate_keeper); tsl_updated payload shrinks to wiring+services (Foreman reconciliation keeps its services relay - recovery-time-only consumer, verified). EXIT-CRITERION AMENDMENT (honest): 'tsl_updated broadcast deleted' becomes 'the broadcast no longer carries shard topology' - FDB itself retains the ClientDBInfo push; deleting wiring distribution would be un-FDB. Known gap noted, out of scope: pure-client nodes (capabilities==[]) never register/subscribe (discovery.ex:177) - pre-existing. PR stack: (1) materializer family + codec + recovery writer + RoutingData fold + seed extension; (2) proxy routing-snapshot endpoint with validState gate; (3) client switch: Link cache + LayoutIndex from snapshot + Repo retry reclassification; (4) TSL field kill + broadcast shrink + dead-field trim. Each TDD'd, cold-audited, stacked onto feature/q67-phase-b-prereqs. Design audit against FDB runs before PR 1.

title: Phase B headline: shard map out of TSL into system keys; retire TSL-delta channel
